rationale: Footnotes *10 and *11 phase the effluent-limits-table concentrations (497 mg/L then 449 mg/L) relative to the permit effective date and a three-year transition. Federal FY2025 (2024-10-01 through 2025-09-30) cannot be placed on that timeline without the permit effective date, which is not present in the packet. Depending on that date, FY2025 could fall entirely under the 497 mg/L phase, entirely under the 449 mg/L phase, or span the transition (e.g., 497 mg/L for early FY2025 and 449 mg/L after the three-year mark). Section B(2) requires achieving the 449 mg/L limit three years after the effective date but does not, without the effective date, identify which table limit governs measurements during the FY2025 monitoring window. Neither a definitive choice of 497 mg/L nor 449 mg/L for FY2025 is established by the available evidence; uncertainty is preserved rather than closed by absence.
